verdict.rationale: OCI documents its own Terraform provider for managing OCI services. It also documents Resource Manager, which can take over existing Terraform state through an import job, so a first-party template-style IaC surface with managed state exists. The evidence shows no typed CDK-style framework and does not document rollback semantics. missing for 10: typed CDK-style IaC framework, documented rollback/drift semantics, depth on Resource Manager state handling, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a platform engineer, infrastructure is code on day one — a first-party IaC surface (templates plus a typed CDK-style framework) with documented state/rollback semantics

citations.quote: The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Terraform provider is a component that connects Terraform to the OCI services that you want to manage.
To migrate an existing Terraform state file to Resource Manager, use an import job
